guard/32175.htm.text: Marksman Bixon: This is the entrance to Kamael Village. No sinner may enter, but all those pure of spirit are welcome within. Here many races unite to raise up new warriors to defend civilization against evil!

links.text: View information on the local lord and tax rate.

Q00280_TheFoodChain/32175-01.htm.text: Marksman Bixon: For some reason, we have recently noticed an increase in numbers of grey keltir and black wolves near the village entrance... By themselves, they are hardly a threat, but we are concerned that more dangerous predators will be drawn to the area as well. That is why we must hunt the g…

Q00280_TheFoodChain/32175-02.htm.text: Marksman Bixon: I admire your willingness to help but... Well, frankly your skills are not yet developed sufficiently to safely hunt the keltir or the wolves. I have no wish to send you out only to fail. Perhaps you can come back after you have acquired a little more experience. (This quest may onl…

Q00280_TheFoodChain/32175-05.html.text: Marksman Bixon: Ah, you've returned... so, how was your hunting? Productive, I hope!

Q00280_TheFoodChain/32175-04.html.text: Marksman Bixon: Go to the village entrance and hunt Young Grey Keltir, Grey Keltir and the Dominant Grey Keltir and bring me the Grey Keltir's teeth. Also hunt the Black Wolf and the Dominant Black Wolf and bring back the teeth of the Black Wolf as well.

Q00280_TheFoodChain/32175-03.htm.text: Marksman Bixon: My thanks for your help! Go near the village entrance and hunt Young Grey Keltir, Grey Keltir and the Dominant Grey Keltir and bring me the Grey Keltir's teeth ... Also, hunt the Black Wolves and the Dominant Black Wolf , and bring me the Teeth of the Black Wolves as well... Once yo…

Q00280_TheFoodChain/32175-06.html.text: Marksman Bixon: Thank you for helping my cause... Here, take this. It's not much, but it's what I promised you. Would you care to continue helping me?

links.text: Say that you wish to quit.

Q00280_TheFoodChain/32175-07.html.text: Marksman Bixon: Uh, where are the teeth? Quickly now, go to the village entrance and hunt Young Grey Keltir, Grey Keltir and the Dominant Grey Keltir and bring me the Grey Keltir's teeth. Also hunt the Black Wolf and the Dominant Black Wolf and bring back the teeth of the Black Wolf as well.

Q00280_TheFoodChain/32175-08.html.text: Marksman Bixon: Thank you for your continued help... Go to the village entrance and hunt Young Grey Keltir, Grey Keltir and the Dominant Grey Keltir and bring me the Grey Keltir's teeth. Also hunt the Black Wolf and the Dominant Black Wolf and bring back the teeth of the Black Wolf as well.

Q00280_TheFoodChain/32175-09.html.text: Marksman Bixon: Want to quit, eh? Can't say that I blame you for not wanting to deal with the likes of the Black Wolf or Grey Keltir any more... But if you change your mind, don't hesitate to come back!

Q00280_TheFoodChain/32175-10.html.text: Marksman Bixon: You need at least 25 Grey Keltir's Teeth or Black Wolf's Teeth in order to exchange them for an item...

Q00280_TheFoodChain/32175-11.html.text: Marksman Bixon: Thank you for helping my cause... Here, take this. It's not much, but it's what I promised you. Would you care to continue helping me?

links.text: Say that you wish to quit.
